You're right, I added that initially and forgot to remove it. I’ll remove it in the next commit and include the other suggested fixes. Thanks for the thorough review!

```suggestion
	Error push_callable_unique(const Callable &p_callable, VarArgs... p_args) {
```
No?
I'm not sure how effective this will be, this will fail if the hash collides, equal hash values don't guarantee equal value

I agree, there's a minimal chance of collision. I wanted to implement this with as little overhead as possible, but I've rewritten it. However, this approach is now nearly 2x slower than regular call_deferred when the callable is not yet in the queue.
That's a good reason to discuss if this is a good idea in general, also the chance isn't necessarily minimal for long names and similar data, it also depends on the fill ratio of the set

You're right, this is worth discussing. On reflection, I think the performance overhead is acceptable in exchange for correctness. Hash collisions could lead to critical bugs if important methods fail to execute due to false deduplication.

It would depend, the bigger question here is if this addition is worth it when there are trivial workarounds that also handle other aspects of the use cases for this, like having a `pending` flag in the class like is done across the codebase, like:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/7dac0bc3be27ee70b1bf6da561e9f14cd92224ef/scene/main/canvas_item.cpp#L472-L484

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/7dac0bc3be27ee70b1bf6da561e9f14cd92224ef/scene/main/canvas_item.cpp#L133-L157

There are aspects of that process case that wouldn't fit perfectly with this method, and I'd say that's true for a lot of cases
